title: Principles relating to processing of personal data
mia_boundary_or_control: Use only documented purposes and approved sources; minimise retrieved fields; restrict retention; protect confidentiality; retain evidence of compliance.

title: Lawfulness of processing
mia_boundary_or_control: A data steward must record and validate the lawful basis before customer or employee data enters a Mia workflow.

title: Special categories of personal data
mia_boundary_or_control: Do not ingest or infer special-category data for insight generation unless Legal and the DPO approve a documented Article 9 condition.

title: Information to data subjects
mia_boundary_or_control: Maintain accessible notices for each source and processing purpose, including automated analysis and relevant recipients.

title: Data-subject rights and automated individual decision-making
mia_boundary_or_control: Mia must support rights-request discovery and must not make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on people.

title: Data protection by design and by default
mia_boundary_or_control: Default retrieval to approved aggregate or pseudonymised context; block unnecessary identity fields from prompts, traces and exports.

title: Processor
mia_boundary_or_control: Use only model, embedding, observability and hosting providers covered by approved processor terms and a data-processing agreement where required.

title: Records of processing activities
mia_boundary_or_control: Maintain a versioned record for every Mia source and workflow: controller/processor, purpose, data categories, recipients, transfers, retention and safeguards.

title: Security of processing
mia_boundary_or_control: Require least-privilege access, enterprise authentication, MFA or SSO, encryption, secret management and audit logs before production use.

title: Personal data breach notification
mia_boundary_or_control: Maintain incident triage that can notify the controller and DPO promptly; preserve only minimum necessary breach evidence.

title: Data protection impact assessment
mia_boundary_or_control: Run and retain a DPIA screening before production processing of internal customer data; escalate a positive screening to Legal and the DPO.

title: Transfers of personal data to third countries
mia_boundary_or_control: Do not send personal data to a non-EEA provider or location without a documented transfer mechanism and approved supplementary safeguards.

title: AI literacy
mia_boundary_or_control: Keep a role-based AI-literacy and training record for operators, reviewers and administrators using or supervising Mia.

title: Prohibited AI practices
mia_boundary_or_control: Do not use Mia for prohibited manipulation, social scoring, emotion inference in work or education, sensitive-trait inference, or other prohibited practices.

title: High-risk classification
mia_boundary_or_control: Treat Mia as decision support only. Reassess with Legal before any use affecting employment, credit, eligibility, law enforcement, migration, education or other Annex III areas.

title: High-risk risk management and data governance
mia_boundary_or_control: If a proposed use is high-risk, stop deployment until a documented lifecycle risk-management system, dataset governance and quality controls are implemented and approved.

title: High-risk transparency human oversight and robustness
mia_boundary_or_control: For any high-risk deployment, provide operating guidance and logging; assign meaningful human oversight; and maintain measured quality, regression and cybersecurity controls.

title: Deployer duties and fundamental-rights impact assessment
mia_boundary_or_control: If Mia is classified high-risk, operate it to instructions, retain logs, monitor performance and assess affected persons, impacts, mitigation and governance before relevant deployment.

title: Transparency obligations for certain AI systems
mia_boundary_or_control: Clearly tell users when they interact with Mia and label generated insights; retain provenance, confidence, evidence and limitations with outputs.

title: Confidentiality of information
mia_boundary_or_control: Limit access to non-public information supplied through regulatory or governance processes and protect it under role-based controls.

title: Right to explanation of individual decision-making
mia_boundary_or_control: Mia must not make individual rights-affecting decisions. If scope changes, provide meaningful, clear explanations and legal review before use.

title: Application timetable
mia_boundary_or_control: Record that the AI Act entered into force on 2024-08-01; Articles 4 and 5 apply from 2025-02-02; most provisions apply from 2026-08-02; apply the amended high-risk timetable below.

title: AI Act implementation timeline amendment
mia_boundary_or_control: For Mia, use 2027-12-02 for Annex III high-risk use cases and 2028-08-02 for Annex I high-risk systems embedded in regulated products; reassess any high-risk scope before development.
